name: Deep-Fried Calypso Crab Cake with Mango-Jalapeño Remoulade (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Lump crab meat is lean protein, but deep-frying the breaded cake and plating it over spicy remoulade and coleslaw adds fat and heat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in remission, eat the soft interior lump crab meat only, scraping off the deep-fried crust, spicy remoulade, and raw slaw.
watchOuts: Jalapeño/citrus in remoulade and raw cabbage slaw
